_comment: Copy to ~/.config/analog_repro/pdk.json (or point PR_PDK_CONFIG at it) and fill in. Keep the real file private: it names your server, libraries and paths.
ssh_host: ssh alias of the machine that runs Virtuoso
work_dir: directory Virtuoso is started in (holds cds.lib)
private_dir: directory on that machine for private outputs (device map, model setup, runs); created with mode 700
remote_tmp: prefix for temporary files on that machine, e.g. /tmp/<user>_pr
shell_init: command that sets up the Cadence environment in a tcsh shell, e.g. source ~/.cshrc >& /dev/null

reference_cell.cell: a schematic that uses the PDK's NMOS and PMOS, with a DC supply source (an inverter is enough)

source_testbench.cell: a testbench (ADE Explorer/Assembler) that already simulates with the PDK models

target_library: an empty library attached to the PDK technology; the pipeline creates and deletes only its own cells there
technology: the technology library the target library is attached to
bridge: path to the virtuoso-bridge executable (for drawing in the live session)
